recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future behavior changes for calculated Questionnaire values should be made in the SDC implementation guide unless FHIR-I explicitly decides to move the extension back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-15674 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Questionnaire request for STU3 asking for a way to specify question values by formula, such as BMI computed from other answers. Its resolution said to use the same approach as scored answers in FHIR-15669 and ensure documentation made clear that the solution worked for both scoring and calculated values.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN #14772, represented in git by b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e. That commit names both 15669 and 15674, adds Questionnaire math/dynamic expression narrative, and included a calculatedExpression Questionnaire extension row using the Expression datatype.
additional_context: Later core history intentionally removed the detailed calculatedExpression row from the core Questionnaire extension spreadsheet and moved related expression-extension material to SDC. Current core and the FHIR Extension Pack do not define calculatedExpression, while the published SDC IG defines active sdc-questionnaire-calculatedExpression with value[x] constrained to Expression.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, and its current notes already direct advanced dynamic questionnaires, including calculated scores, to SDC and link dynamic values to expression guidance. Re-adding the SDC extension definition to core would conflict with later ownership.

related_jiras.note: The seed resolution explicitly reused the scored-answer approach from this Published companion issue.
Later scoring clarification updated current Questionnaire itemWeight wording and shows the scoring side has its own subsequent issue family.
Renamed the ordinalValue scoring-extension lineage to itemWeight, explaining current scoring terminology.
